description: For the code the buyer received: answers the quote, or the hold and who must act. The quote is an exact amount (price, 5% Texas sales tax and a small unique tail), a receive address and a 20-minute window to send it, from the wallet declared. The agent never pays: the buyer sends from their own wallet. Paying publishes nothing by itself: a person at Aruon reviews the build, and the site owner approves a preview before anything goes live.
name: confirm_crypto_payment
title: Confirm a crypto payment
